title: UCaaS · Sign in
head:
<meta name="robots" content="noindex">
<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="assets/favicon.svg">

<style>
@font-face{font-family:"Filson Pro";font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(assets/fonts/filson-0.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Filson Pro";font-weight:500;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(assets/fonts/filson-1.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Filson Pro";font-weight:600;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(assets/fonts/filson-2.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Filson Pro";font-weight:800;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(assets/fonts/filson-3.woff2) format("woff2")}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0}
.auth-switch{font-family:'Filson Pro','Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FF7A5C 0%,#F5C46B 100%);min-height:100vh;width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:stretch;padding:0}
.container{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:none;height:100vh;height:100svh;min-height:560px;background:white;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;overflow:hidden}
.forms-container{position:absolute;width:100%;height:100%;top:0;left:0}
.signin-signup{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);left:75%;width:50%;transition:1s .7s ease-in-out;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;z-index:5}
form{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;padding:0 5rem;transition:all .2s .7s;overflow:hidden;grid-column:1/2;grid-row:1/2}
form.sign-up-form{opacity:0;z-index:1}
form.sign-in-form{z-index:2}
.title{font-size:2.2rem;color:#444;margin:0 0 10px;font-weight:700}
.input-field{max-width:380px;width:100%;background-color:#f0f0f0;margin:10px 0;height:55px;border-radius:55px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:15% 85%;padding:0 .4rem;position:relative;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px transparent;transition:background-color .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.input-field:focus-within{background-color:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(232,85,58,.65),0 0 0 4px rgba(232,85,58,.13),0 10px 22px -14px rgba(232,85,58,.5)}
.input-field i{display:grid;place-items:center;color:#8a837c;transition:.3s;font-style:normal}.input-field i svg{width:20px;height:20px}.input-field:focus-within i{color:#E8553A}
.input-field input{background:none;outline:none;border:none;line-height:1;font-weight:500;font-size:1rem;color:#333;width:100%;font-family:inherit}
.input-field input::placeholder{color:#aaa;font-weight:400}
.btn{width:150px;background-color:#E8553A;border:none;outline:none;height:49px;border-radius:49px;color:#fff;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;margin:10px 0;cursor:pointer;transition:.5s;font-size:.9rem;font-family:inherit}
.btn:hover{background-color:#D4452B;transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 5px 15px rgba(232,85,58,.4)}
.panels-container{position:absolute;height:100%;width:100%;top:0;left:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-around;text-align:center;z-index:6}
.left-panel{pointer-events:all;padding:3rem 17% 2rem 12%}
.right-panel{pointer-events:none;padding:3rem 12% 2rem 17%}
.panel .content{color:#fff;transition:transform .9s ease-in-out;transition-delay:.6s}
.panel h3{font-weight:600;line-height:1;font-size:1.5rem;margin:0 0 10px}
.panel p{font-size:.95rem;padding:.7rem 0;margin:0}
.btn.transparent{margin:0;background:none;border:2px solid #fff;width:130px;height:41px;font-weight:600;font-size:.8rem;box-shadow:none}
.btn.transparent:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:none}
.right-panel .content{transform:translateX(120vw)}
.container.sign-up-mode:before{transform:translate(100%,-50%);right:52%}
.container.sign-up-mode .left-panel .content{transform:translateX(-120vw)}
.container.sign-up-mode .signin-signup{left:25%}
.container.sign-up-mode form.sign-up-form{opacity:1;z-index:2}
.container.sign-up-mode form.sign-in-form{opacity:0;z-index:1}
.container.sign-up-mode .right-panel .content{transform:translateX(0%)}
.container.sign-up-mode .left-panel{pointer-events:none}
.container.sign-up-mode .right-panel{pointer-events:all}
.container:before{content:"";position:absolute;height:364vh;width:364vh;min-height:2040px;min-width:2040px;top:-10%;right:48%;transform:translateY(-50%);background:linear-gradient(-45deg,#E8553A 0%,#F5A24B 100%);transition:1.8s ease-in-out;border-radius:50%;z-index:6}
.social-text{padding:.7rem 0;font-size:1rem;color:#666;margin:0}
.social-media{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:15px}
.social-icon{height:46px;width:46px;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:50%;color:#E8553A;font-size:1.2rem;transition:.3s;cursor:pointer}
.social-icon:hover{border-color:#F5A24B;transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.social-icon svg{transition:.3s}
@media(min-width:1100px){.title{font-size:2.8rem;margin-bottom:14px}.input-field{max-width:440px;height:62px;border-radius:62px;margin:12px 0}.input-field i svg{width:22px;height:22px}.input-field input{font-size:1.1rem}.btn{width:180px;height:56px;border-radius:56px;font-size:1rem}.social-text{font-size:1.05rem}.social-icon{height:52px;width:52px}.panel h3{font-size:2rem}.panel p{font-size:1.1rem;max-width:380px}.btn.transparent{width:150px;height:46px;font-size:.9rem}}
@media(max-width:870px){
 .container{min-height:800px;height:100vh}
 .signin-signup{width:100%;top:95%;transform:translate(-50%,-100%);transition:1s .8s ease-in-out}
 .signin-signup,.container.sign-up-mode .signin-signup{left:50%}
 .panels-container{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:1fr 2fr 1fr}
 .panel{flex-direction:row;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;padding:2.5rem 8%;grid-column:1/2}
 .right-panel{grid-row:3/4}
 .left-panel{grid-row:1/2}
 .panel .content{padding-right:15%;transition:transform .9s ease-in-out;transition-delay:.8s}
 .panel h3{font-size:1.2rem}
 .panel p{font-size:.7rem;padding:.5rem 0}
 .btn.transparent{width:110px;height:35px;font-size:.7rem}
 .container:before{min-width:0;min-height:0;width:1500px;height:1500px;transform:translateX(-50%);left:30%;bottom:68%;right:initial;top:initial;transition:2s ease-in-out}
 .container.sign-up-mode:before{transform:translate(-50%,100%);bottom:32%;right:initial}
 .container.sign-up-mode .left-panel .content{transform:translateY(-300px)}
 .container.sign-up-mode .right-panel .content{transform:translateY(0px)}
 .right-panel .content{transform:translateY(300px)}
 .container.sign-up-mode .signin-signup{top:5%;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
}
@media(max-width:570px){form{padding:0 1.5rem}.panel .content{padding:.5rem 1rem}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.signin-signup,.container:before,.panel .content,form{transition:none!important}}
.container.no-anim,.container.no-anim *,.container.no-anim:before{transition:none!important}
.social-icon:focus-visible,.btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #2B2622;outline-offset:2px}
.input-field input:focus-visible{outline:none}
</style><link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/perf.css">
